rationale: Most ground-truth inline comments target an earlier stage_kv/interface.py revision that no longer exists in this diff snapshot, capping recall for both, but X's DTO-invariant finding (#2) independently reconstructs almost exactly asukaqaq-s's three-tier validation taxonomy, and its overlapping-identity-checks finding (#7) echoes the same 'consolidate to one canonical validator' theme — the closest either candidate gets to the ground truth's central critique. Both independently and correctly flag the unpatched ARDiffusionModelRunner override and the untested DLO+metadata fallback, and both are well-grounded with accurate line citations (X's '16 passed' test count is verifiably correct). Y is exhaustively evidenced but denser and less scannable, and its findings (missing pre-RPC validation in batch/step paths, wrapper-vs-execute_method test mismatch) are real but more tangential to what the human reviewers actually flagged. X's prioritized Required/Should-fix/Minor structure with concrete diffs is more directly actionable.
